title: cover writes a test only when it asserts behaviour
description: ork:cover drops its 90% business logic coverage target and picks targets by risk (changed code, complex branches, error paths, security and money paths, past bugs), recording why each was chosen. A new Phase 3b runs src/skills/cover/scripts/check-behaviour-tests.mjs over the new test files and rejects tests that only assert mock calls, assert nothing, or read the source instead of executing it. Pick a committed fixture and read the checker's real per-test verdicts.
